e item offered by the bidder as part of the bidding process. The technical evaluation of the item quoted by the bidder shall be conducted on any convenient date. The exact date, time and venue for the technical e valuation will be communicated to the bidders in due course. 7. The Technical evaluation shall be carried out to verify compliance with the technical Specifications r equired by SPG. Technical Specification 25 KVA modular UPS with Li-Ion battery Module: S/ No Minimum Requirement Documentary . Compliance (Y/N) on Reference OEM Letter head 1. UPS needs to Transformer less and 3P hase input and 3phase output, IGBT R ectifier & IGBT Inverter Modular Hot S wappable UPS System of 25KW + 1 Ex tra Module for redundancy Modular ho t swappable UPS operating in parallel Configuration, scalable to minimum 7 5 kW Modular UPS Frame in single fra me 2. The UPS Frame shall be of modular fa ult tolerant and Hot Swappable both w ith hot swappable sub power modules rating of 25 kW-40KW along with fully rated i.e.,75KVA centralized Static Byp ass Switch. Only fault tolerant module not accepted 3. User shall be able to replace the mod ules himself without shutting down or shifting the UPS to bypass, battery mo de or maintenance bypass mode. Bidd er to ensure that Module shall be repl aced in Online Mode without using an y external or internal switch such that no raw power directly goes to data ce nter or Critical load during addition or removal of power Module. 4. The UPS shall be designed with minim um 3 Level Inverter design or better t echnology 5. The UPS shall be rated for kVA = kW a t 40 Deg C Continuous without deratin g.) If UPS KVA rating is applicable at a lower ambient temperature than spe cified 40 deg.c, the bidder shall co nsider a derating factor of at least 1. 5%/deg.c for arriving at the specified UPS capacity at 40 deg.c ambient.

6. Failure of any sub power module in an individual UPS Frame shall not lead to entire Frame Capacity Down but only the failed sub power module capacity shall go down. i.e., In case of Failure o f any one Sub Power module, the rest of the available power module in the f rame shall continue to operate in nor mal double conversion mode of operat ion with reduced capacity. This shall al so be applicable to all UPS’s operating in parallel configuration 7. The UPS power modules to be hot swa ppable in online mode and when instal led and operated in parallel configurat ion 8. It shall be possible to interchange the sub power modules among each other in the frame or from any of the other s imilar frames without the need of shut down or programming required by the OEM / Service Team 9. The UPS shall be provided with Inbuilt Phase Sequence Correction at Input i. e. In case of Phase reversal at Input, U PS shall continue to operate in Double Conversion Mode of operation without going to battery mode. 10. Minimum 8 nos. Paralleling feature to have in the offered UPS. 11. Each Modular Chassis to have inbuilt it s own input /output/bypass and maint enance bypass isolator. GAD of UPS to be submitted along with the bid highli ghting internal switchgear 12. Input Current Distortion <3% @100% Linear load, Total output voltage disto rtion <1% at 100% linear load, <5% f or rated / reference non-linear load 13. Washable Dust filters require at front door of UPS to avoid frequent changin g of dust filter. Documentary proof sh ould be attached 14. Bypass Transfer time breaker to be N o break in Synchronized Condition, 2 ms typical in unsynchronized conditio n. Documentary Proof to be shared 15. For improving Energy Saving @ low lo ad condition, each power modules of Modular UPS should have sleep mode feature when load is less and should b e having an auto awake feature witho ut manual intervention or putting syst em in overload or bypass. Sleep mode should also have a feature to cater su dden changes of workload. Awakening time of power module to be less than 2 muse Documentary explanation of t his feature shall be provided 16. Paralleling of UPS to be continue work ing in paralleling mode even in the ca se of failure of parallel cable between the two UPS

17. Offered UPS to have Online efficiency > 96% @ 50%, 75% and 100% Linear Load and to be greater than 95% @ 2 5% Linear Load. Efficiency Type test r eport to be attached from Meity appro ved lab such as ETDC or NABL for effic iency proof of same power module us ed in the frame 18. UPS to have its own Type test report i n accordance with IEC62040-3 from M eity approved lab such as ETDC or NA BL 19. UPS to have Touchscreen Color displa y with and 4 separate summary LEDs f or system status for distant monitorin g 20. All Parallel UPS parameter can be see n from any of one UPS working in para llel. Individual load and overall load ca n be seen from one of the UPS display s. This feature to be demonstrated at the site 21. UPS shall be capable of testing at 100 % Load without the need of any exter nal load bank. In case this feature is n ot built-in, an external fully rated load bank of UPS capacity along with break ers and cables shall be considered wh ich will be kept at site till the warrant y period of the UPS. 22. Single Combo SNMP CARD+ Modbus C ard to be provided it should be having gigabit speed and should be having c yber security certification UL2900. A V alid Certificate to be provided. Also, C ERT-IN Vulnerability report to be attac hed highlighting zero vulnerability. UP S OEM also to be authorized cyber sec urity auditor by UL or IEC

23. • The UPS battery shall be sized fo r 60 minutes Ul9540a (At Cell Level, Module Level and rack level) Lithium i on battery backup at Unity power fact or with UPS Frame at 25 kVA load con sidering 85% DOD or 15% Ageing Mar gin. Minimum 34.6 KWHR to supplied on each UPS as a mandatory requirem ent • Type of Battery: Lithium Ion Batt ery with LMO-NCM or equivalent chem istry • Cycle life (@25℃,1C/1C, 100% DOD) shall be ≥ 2500 Cycles • Each battery cabinet shall featur e a DC rated circuit breaker for control and protection. The circuit breaker wit hin the battery cabinet shall only prov ide protection to the battery string wit hin that battery cabinet. • Protection: i. Over / Under Voltage ii. Over / Low temperature iii. Over Current. iv. Short Circuit. 24. Inbuilt Rack based Battery Monitoring System: Monitor + Control along with balance charging. Individual Module L evel, Rack Level & System Level shall be provided with each UPS with LIB sy stem. The BMS shall provide SOC (Sta te of Charge), SOH (State of Health), V oltage and Temperature for each Cell and Module within the LIB rack. The P C based external BMS is not acceptabl e. Lithium-ion batteries should be suppli ed according to the OEM standard mo del, complete with a Battery Manage ment System (BMS) and rack provided by the OEM of the lithium-ion batteries . This ensures the highest quality and maintains all applicable safety certific ations at the rack level. The quoted m odel should also be listed on the globa l OEM website or available on the UPS OEM website.

25. Standard / Certified: - 1-Safety Module UL1973, 2-Cell UL1642 3-Seismic GR63 4-EMC IEC61000-6-2, 61000-6-4 and O ffered Lithium-ion batteries 5-Mandato ry UL9540a tested at Cell Level, Modul e Level and at Rack/Unit Level. Lithiu m batteries having UL9540a tested on ly at Cell Level will not be accepted fo r complete safety. A Mandatory Certif icated to be submitted along with the bid highlighting the quoted model for Verification. The quoted model must b e tested and passed with the UL9540a standard, with a pass remark clearly i ndicated in the report. 6-UL 991 applies to controls using soli d-state devices used in LIB 7-UL 1998 pertains to software in prog rammable components. All above certification to be shared along with the bid for verification 26. Onsite warranty on UPS -5 years and 10 years warranty on Lithium-ion batt eries. 9. Additional Terms and Conditions · Onsite Complete installation up-to output end terminals included. · Quarterly maintenance till Onsite warranty of UPS (05 Years). · Bid specific MAF from OEM. · Datasheet and Boucher of the proposed UPS and LITHIUM-ION Battery · UPS and batteries GAD to be provided · Cybersecurity UL2900 Certificate and CERT-IN VAPT Report to be provided. · Inbuilt Phase sequence corrector documentary evidence · Paralleling method documentary evidence. · Sleep Mode feature documentary evidence. · Battery Backup Calculation Sheet. · A tentative room layout of the solution. · Proposed SLD. · Meity approved lab test report for efficiency proof. · UL9540a certificate tested at Cell Level, Module Level and at Rack/Unit Level. · UL1642, UL1973, UL 991 and UL 1998 certifications. · Make in India Compliance. .
